proposition: Melvin-Koushki says Ibn Turka, in his K. al-Manāhij (Natanz, 833/1430, for his son Jamāl al-Dīn Muḥammad), rejected some post-Avicennan developments in logic as breaking unduly with the ancients.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, paraphrasing or translating Ibn Turka's own work
mediation.note: Melvin-Koushki's footnote cites El-Rouayheb's study of the work
